_comment: Assets that cannot enter an Addressables content build yet. Generated by tools/unity-rebuild/plan_exclusions_by_stub_fields.py --write; every entry is evidence-backed (see the observed errors in _investigation).
_investigation: The content build aborts on the first component whose field graph reaches a stub type (UniRx/UniTask/LitMotion/TrueShadow/MPUIKit/UIPolygon/FastEnum): GenerateLocationListsTask -> AddressableAssetEntry.GatherMainAndReferencedSerializedTypes -> ContentBuildInterface.GetTypeForObjects throws 'Invalid type ... for instance field ...' or 'TypeLoadException: VTable setup of type UniRx.CompositeDisposable failed'. Because the prefab graph is rebuilt in full since round 9, more components are present and the walk reaches more stub types; the affected prefab set is therefore computed from the sources and the plan instead of being discovered one 4-minute build at a time. Attempted fix that did NOT work: marking 98 stub-typed fields [NonSerialized] (tools/unity-rebuild/annotate_nonserialized_stub_fields.py) -- Unity's type walk looks at fields regardless. Real unblock: a genuine UniRx dependency.
